fusions.name: Blinked First
fusions.desc: A jet of musk into the eyes of an enemy at or below 25% health and up to 7 tiles away, dealing 20 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at maximum range, and leaving it [Blunted] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Every Lid Streaming
fusions.desc: Sprays a cone 4 tiles long at face height, dealing 26 damage that ignores armour to everything in it and leaving it [Marked] for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Sighted Down the Stripe
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Sharp Focus
fusions.desc: You deal 10% more damage to enemies carrying your afflictions.
